records.issue_text: The group member template resolves automatic in the member context where it is absent, incorrectly showing removal links for automatic-group members
records.rationale: group_member.hbs is rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in group.hbs, so the template's context is the member (a Discourse.User), not the group controller. The `{{#unless automatic}}` guard therefore evaluates `automatic` on the member object, where it is undefined, so the removal link is shown for members of automatic groups even though the surrounding controller has `automatic` set true (the outer addMembers block is correctly guarded by the controller's `automatic`). records.issue_text: The members API accepts limit and offset without bounds validation, allowing negative values that may cause database errors and arbitrarily large expensive queries
records.rationale: The new public groups#members endpoint does `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` with no clamping/validation, then passes them to `members.limit(limit).offset(offset)`. This is a user-facing (non-admin) route per the controller's guardian usage. Negative offset values produce invalid SQL (Postgres requires non-negative OFFSET), and unbounded limit permits arbitrarily large queries.
